name: Nushell
summary: Cross-platform shell built on structured data (tables, records) with the reedline editor, a typed scripting language and autoload-directory configuration.
configFormat: Nushell script ($nu.default-config-dir: env.nu, config.nu, login.nu, autoload/*.nu)
startupCostMs: Not measured here (nu is not installed on the verification machine). It is a single Rust binary; cost is parsing config.nu and autoload files plus any init script you generate. Measure with Measure-Command { nu -c exit } vs nu -n -c exit.

install.notes: User scope by default; machine scope: --override 'ALLUSERS=1'.

windows.notes: Config dir is $nu.default-config-dir = %APPDATA%\nushell (C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\nushell); XDG_CONFIG_HOME overrides it on every OS. Not a login shell by default: set it in the terminal profile (Windows Terminal commandline `nu`).

macos.notes: Config dir is ~/Library/Application Support/nushell unless XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set (then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nushell).

install.notes: From the official apt.fury.io/nushell repository (see the Nushell install docs); not in default Debian/Ubuntu repos.

linux.notes: Config dir is ~/.config/nushell ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nushell). Add nu to /etc/shells before chsh.

prompt.notes: PROMPT_COMMAND / PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT closures and native TRANSIENT_PROMPT_* variables.

line-editing.notes: reedline: emacs/vi/helix, history hints, completion menus; syntax highlighting built in.

completion.notes: Built-in plus external completer closure (carapace, fish).
